title: COGNITIVELY-INSPIRED TOKENS OVERCOME EGOCENTRIC BIAS IN MULTIMODAL MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating spatial reasoning accuracy on visual perspective-taking benchmarks (Perspective-Taking, Isle Bricks V2, COCO, 3DSRBench) by systematically varying the reference agent's orientation alignment (aligned vs. unaligned) with the viewer's perspective to see if the model can adopt an allocentric viewpoint.
